title: Vishwanath & Sons
synopsis: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: Modha Rathri
synopsis: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

title: Once More
synopsis: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

title: Sardar 2
synopsis: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

title: Mandaadi
synopsis: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: Delivery Boy
synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

title: Hi!
synopsis: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

title: Immortal
synopsis: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

title: Poovellaam Kettuppaar
synopsis: A research project pulls Sathiya and Kartigeyan into the isolated world of Maaran and Nathiya. As the past meets the present, one conversation is all it takes to change their lives forever.

title: Selvi
synopsis: After her best friend Kavitha’s sudden collapse, Selvi, a home care nurse, takes on her shifts in addition to her own, determined to hold everything together. Moving from one house to another, she spends her days caring for the elderly, rarely stopping to rest. As the long hours blur the boundaries between care and exhaustion, Selvi begins to confront the weight of guilt, love, and survival.

title: The Dark Heaven
synopsis: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

title: Rage
synopsis: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

title: Kitti
synopsis: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

title: BeeP
synopsis: BeeP is a mind-bending crime-fantasy about Ilandevan, a young man who can step inside photographs and uncover the thoughts hidden behind them. But when a life-changing event leaves his extraordinary ability useless, he must find another way to uncover the truth while two seemingly unrelated worlds of college dreams, drugs and murder collide.

title: Dorothy
synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.
